data.name: Natesh
data.gender_notes: Natesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nata: Lord, Shiva: The Cause. Natesh refers to the deity Shiva, the Lord of the Cause or the Lord of Dharma. He is the supreme God in Hinduism, worshipped as the embodiment of pure consciousness. The name Natesh carries the meaning “Lord of the Cause” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Natesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the cause and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine protection, wisdom, and power.
data.etymology: Natesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Cause.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Natesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Natesh" signifies the deep reverence and devotion that the Hindu culture holds towards Lord Shiva. It is a name strongly associated with Hindu spiritual traditions, reminding us of the profound influence Shiva has had on Hindu philosophy, art, and music.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Natesh can be seen as a reminder of the ultimate cause behind all existence, the divine consciousness that lies within each of us and transforms us into our highest potential. Worshipping Lord Shiva as Natesh brings us closer to this divine reality and connects us with the inner light that guides our spiritual journey. The vibration of the name Natesh invokes the energies of creation, transformation, and destruction, helping us understand the deep cycles of life and the importance of an eternal perspective.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Natesh is a name derived from Lord Shiva, symbolizing the ruler of dance and music in the universe, representing joy, creativity, and the divine connection between the Creator and creation.

vedic_reference.note: Natesh is a popular name for Lord Shiva, also known as Nataraja or the Lord of Dance.

historical_references.reference: Natesh is a name found in the ancient Tamil literature, particularly in the works of the Sangam period.

historical_references.context: Natesh is a popular name in ancient Tamil literature.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Natesh remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
